# SSE4.2 is below AVX: not an AVX-class grant.
set_source_files_properties(src/kernels/vm_sse42.cpp TARGET_DIRECTORY helios_pcg PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-msse4.2")
target_compile_options(helios_pcg PRIVATE -Wall "-DDOC=a#b") # a quoted # is not a comment: -mavx2
set(_pcg_avx -mavx2)
set(_pcg_opt -O2)
foreach(_pcg_a _pcg_o IN ZIP_LISTS _pcg_avx _pcg_opt)
  target_compile_options(helios_pcg PRIVATE ${_pcg_o})
endforeach()
foreach(_pcg_z IN ZIP_LISTS _pcg_avx _pcg_opt)
  target_compile_options(helios_pcg PRIVATE ${_pcg_z_1})
endforeach()
foreach(_pcg_o2 _pcg_a2 IN ZIP_LISTS _pcg_opt _pcg_avx)
endforeach()
target_compile_options(helios_pcg PRIVATE ${_pcg_a2})
target_compile_options(helios_pcg PRIVATE "-march=x86-64" "/arch:SSE2" -mfpmath=sse)
set(CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "$ENV{HELIOS_PREFIX};${CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH}")
find_file(_pcg_layer layer.json PATHS "$ENV{VULKAN_SDK}/share")
